label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be _____; I will make him an help meet for him.
verse: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
note: The first 'not good' in the Bible — after six days of 'good,' solitude is the one thing God corrects.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Fear not, O land; be _____ and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
verse: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
note: After the locust plague, Joel turns it around: fear not, O land — be glad, the LORD will do great things.

label: Sunday School
prompt: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish _____, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
verse: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
note: Achan's confession: a goodly Babylonish garment, some silver, a wedge of gold — 'I coveted them, and took them.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little _____ out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
verse: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
note: After three and a half years of drought, Elijah's servant spots a hand-sized cloud — then the sky turns black.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and _____, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verse: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
note: The great supper's last invitation: go out to the highways and 'hedges' — anywhere — and fill the house.
